zh.title: 土耳其航空傳與利物浦簽下五年逾四億美元贊助合約
zh.summary: 土耳其航空將取代Standard Chartered成為利物浦球衣新贊助商
body: 根據航空新聞網站 Simple Flying 的報導，土耳其航空（Turkish Airlines）預計將與利物浦足球俱樂部（Liverpool FC）達成一項新的贊助協議。這項正在進行中的合作案合約期限為五年，據報導其總價值將會超過4億美元。
根據這項全新的合作協議，土耳其航空將會取代原本在利物浦球衣上的 Standard Chartered。該項報導指出，這筆高達4億美元以上的贊助交易目前已引起廣泛關注，但具體細節仍有待相關雙方正式公佈。

en.title: Turkish Airlines Reportedly Agrees $400 Million Sponsorship Deal With Liverpool FC
en.summary: Turkish Airlines reportedly agreed a five-year, 400 million dollar shirt sponsorship deal with Liverpool FC.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, Turkish Airlines is currently expected to secure a major new sponsorship deal with Liverpool FC. Under this proposed partnership, which is reportedly scheduled to span a five-year period, the airline is expected to establish a highly visible brand presence with the club.

As part of the reported agreement, Turkish Airlines is set to replace Standard Chartered on Liverpool's shirt. The sponsorship deal is reportedly valued at more than 400 million dollars overall, although official confirmation of the final terms has yet to be formally announced by either of the involved parties.

zh.title: 日本航空成為2026亞洲運動會官方供應商
zh.summary: 日本航空簽約；擔任亞運及亞洲帕運客運航空服務供應商
body: 日本航空（Japan Airlines, JAL）已簽約成為第20屆亞洲運動會及第5屆亞洲帕拉運動會的官方供應商。亞運會將於2026年9月19日至10月4日舉行，亞洲帕拉運動會則於10月18日至24日舉行，兩項賽事地點皆位於日本愛知縣與名古屋市。
根據與「愛知·名古屋亞洲運動會暨亞洲帕拉運動會組織委員會」的協議，JAL將擔任兩項賽事的官方客運航空運輸服務提供者。日本航空指出，此夥伴關係旨在支持主辦地區旅遊與經濟活動，並促成亞洲各地運動員、粉絲與社群的交流。
日本航空表示，旗下共有4位具運動員身分的員工將參加本屆賽事，包括標槍選手北口榛花、銳劍選手見延和靖、跳遠選手小浦綾香與110公尺跨欄選手拉希德·穆拉塔克（Rachid Muratake）。

en.title: Japan Airlines named official supplier and air travel provider for 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games
en.summary: JAL signs as official supplier; to provide passenger air transport for 2026 Asian and Asian Para Games
body: Japan Airlines (JAL) has signed on as an official supplier to the 20th Asian Games, scheduled for September 19 to October 4, 2026, and the 5th Asian Para Games, scheduled for October 18 to 23, both to be held in Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya City, Japan.

Under the agreement with the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games and Asian Para Games Organizing Committee, JAL will serve as the official passenger air transport services provider for both events, according to the airline.

JAL said the partnership aims to boost tourism and economic activity in the Tokai region. The carrier also noted that four of its athlete employees will compete in the games, including javelin thrower Haruka Kitaguchi, épée fencer Koki Kano, long jumper Ayaka Kora, and 110-meter hurdler Rachid Muratake.
